leads: Admissibility is asserted to persist for the twisted group ad(P), and the resulting corollary is used to reduce triviality of pointed-torsor automorphisms to the next rigidity proposition.

Proposition 3 asserts that sections agreeing at one point agree everywhere; reduced connected S is inserted. The bracketed strengthening identifies a connected component whose reduction maps isomorphically to S, with reciprocal induced by the section.

The final definition of minimal pointed torsor has a potentially reversed contracted-product formula, literally (P′,ξ′) ×_G G′, and gives G without a clear prime as the group of (P′,ξ′). Keep this as a reading question rather than silently repairing it.
